method: NAIVE. Written straight from the deposited text using only the writing-l4-rules skill. No pipeline, no coverage table, no probe record, no independent test pass, no human gate. One pass, no review.
edition_encoded: Property Tax Act 1960 (Singapore), 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/ (amendments to Act 33 of 2022).; and the Property Tax (Rates for Residential Premises) Order 2013 (S 691/2013), current version as at 11 October 2026, deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/PTA1960-S691-2013.txt
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is reproduced under the standing grant in SSO's Terms of Use cl.13 - see ../../SOURCE-LICENSE.md

checks.command: l4 run ptx-cases-core.l4; l4 run ptx-owner-occupier-cases.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: SCOPED to the owner's obligations and remedies, one module. s 2 (annual value) as used, s 6 (charge, the $18 floor, exemptions, deduction from rent, refunds), s 9(1) (the statutory 36% rate), s 19(1), (3), (4) (notices of sale and demolition), s 20A (objections), s 29(4) (late appeals), s 35A (pay despite objection), s 36 (late-payment penalty), s 47 (seller's continuing liability). Not encoded: Part 2, s 7, ss 10 to 18 and 20 to 22 otherwise, the Valuation Review Board, recovery by attachment and sale, Part 6 (names and numbers), Part 7 (offences) and Part 8. ptx-owner-occupier.l4 encodes the Property Tax (Rates for Residential Premises) Order 2013: paragraphs 3, 4 (owner-occupation, the married-couple one-home rule, continuation after death), 6 and 7, and Schedule Parts 1 (owner-occupied, 2025 on) and 2 (not owner-occupied, 2023 and 2024 on); and the earlier owner-occupier tables (2015 to 2024) from IRAS, which the current Order no longer contains. Added for REQ-0010 and REQ-0264. ptx-core.l4 keeps the rate as a parameter.
